subtitle: Lesson 3 · The Weekly Sales & Fulfillment Report

code:
SELECT soh.SalesOrderID, soh.OrderDate, soh.DueDate,
       soh.ShipDate, tr.Name AS TerritoryName,
       p.Name AS ProductName, psc.Name AS SubcategoryName,
       sod.OrderQty, sod.LineTotal
FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader AS soh
JOIN Sales.SalesOrderDetail AS sod ON sod.SalesOrderID = soh.SalesOrderID
JOIN Sales.SalesTerritory AS tr ON tr.TerritoryID = soh.TerritoryID
JOIN Production.Product AS p ON p.ProductID = sod.ProductID
LEFT JOIN Production.ProductSubcategory AS psc
    ON psc.ProductSubcategoryID = p.ProductSubcategoryID
WHERE soh.Status = 5;
caption: Five real AdventureWorks2012 tables, joined to sanity-check the data first.

code:
-- INNER JOIN: Header, Detail, Territory, Product
--   every order line always has exactly one match

-- LEFT JOIN: Product -> ProductSubcategory
--   some products have a NULL ProductSubcategoryID
caption: A LEFT JOIN here keeps those order lines instead of silently dropping them.
